For runners and walkers who want
to improve, this book offers
programs and practical tips to go
farther while enjoying exercise
more than ever. Olympian Jeff
Galloway offers detailed advice
on how to build the length of a
run or walk without injury – and run
faster. There’s plenty of practical
advice in the areas of nutrition,
running form, special sports drinks,
motivation, avoiding aches and
pains, and lots more.
